name: Kron'zek's Cruelty
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Kron'zek's Cruelty

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Electrifying
effects.tooltip: Electrifying 2 : This effect causes the edges of this weapon to arc with electricity, dealing 2d6 Lightning damage on each hit.

effects.name: Maiming
effects.tooltip: Maiming : This weapon has a twisted haft or grip and spikes along its blade, head, or point. When you score a critical hit with this weapon, it does an additional +2d8 damage.

effects.name: Bleeding
effects.tooltip: Bleeding 2 : This weapon is wickedly curved, with spines and hooks meant to cause damage to those with flesh. This weapon does 2d8 bleeding damage to those that are vulnerable to it.

flavor_text: A scimitar imbued with the essence of a powerful blue abishai . Sparks fly from its edge, and it delivers grievous wounds on critical hits .

source.raw: Under the Big Top , Kron'zek 's chest
